label: Alpine Commit Feed
description: Alpine commit feed — friendly mobile-marketing card: a scannable list of notable commits (kind icon + title + PR, area chip + author + reviewers + date) with a signal status bar (green win / amber warn / neutral). Alpine-light by default; the FFmpeg Weekly Pulse uses preset:"dark". v2 rebuilds the geometry as a RATIO layout (nested row/col splits with proportional weights) so it composes at any canvas without the absolute-placement precision blowup.

rows.label: Rows
rows.description: Feed rows. Each: title (+ optional kind, author, date, pr, reviewers, area, signal).

preset.label: Preset
preset.description: Alpine theme variant (light default; dark = the FFmpeg hero look).

showHeader.label: Show header
showHeader.description: Show the icon + title + subtitle band (default true). False when a parent chrome supplies the title.

accent.label: Accent
accent.description: Accent color (header chip). Defaults to the theme primary.

backgroundColor.label: Card color
backgroundColor.description: Card surface color. "black@0" → transparent (composed under a chrome).

washColor.label: Wash base
washColor.description: Solid color the row tiles blend against (for transparent surfaces on a colored backdrop).

anim.renderMode.label: Render mode
anim.renderMode.description: "premium" (default): rows cascade in via alpha fade — a geq per faded source. "light": the same cascade via free enable-gate pops — no geq, composable, cheap when nested.

anim.reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
anim.reduceMotion.description: Skip motion; render the final static card.

anim.introFrac.label: Intro length
anim.introFrac.description: Share of the clip the intro fills (the rest holds).

theme.slug.label: Producer slug
theme.slug.description: Producer template to seed tokens from (e.g. "@m0saic/theming/v1").

theme.namespace.label: Namespace
theme.namespace.description: Upstream alias to read tokens from. Default "theme".

theme.forceFetch.label: Force fetch
theme.forceFetch.description: Re-seed via the slug even if the namespace is populated.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Opt into a theme source. Uses the alpine preset by default; set a producer slug + namespace to pull shared design tokens. Explicit color props still win.

icon.label: Icon
icon.description: Named header glyph (shared alpine catalog). A derived HUMAN view of the raw iconPath agent prop: picking a name WRITES the SVG path into iconPath (the stored, code-friendly value); a bespoke agent-written path shows as no selection.

iconPath.label: Icon path (SVG d)
iconPath.description: Header glyph SVG path d (24×24) — the raw value behind the friendly `icon` knob, and the override that wins.

kindColors.label: Kind colors
kindColors.description: kind → chip color override (open-keyed map). Built-ins already cover feat, fix, perf, docs, test, chore, refactor, revert, security, ci, deps — this map restyles them or colors CUSTOM kinds.

kindGlyphs.label: Kind glyphs
kindGlyphs.description: kind → chip glyph override (open-keyed map). Values are a mark NAME (add, dash, up, lines, check, dot, shield, back, diamond, box, blocks) or a raw 24x24 SVG path starting with "M" — e.g. {"hotfix": "shield"}.

debugLayout.label: Debug layout
debugLayout.description: Dev-only layout contract view: renders the contract wireframe instead of the feed — rows GREEN with the measured rule when every row is the same size, offenders RED when not. Deterministic default false; production never sets it.
